script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: The oven timer joke has no clear connection to meditating on God's law all day, so the comparison does not click.
Breakfast is a food or meal outside the permitted food exceptions.
Lunch is a meal outside the permitted food exceptions.
The line about the faces the teachers made invents a reaction the text does not give.
Wanting to hear the teachers' faces does not make sense, and the joke makes their imagined reaction the target.
The verse does not say that false ways become easy to spot.
The correction from finding a Lego to finding a lamp makes the joke unclear rather than delivering a coherent comparison.
The psalmist says he has inclined his heart to perform God's statutes to the end. The explanation turns that intention into a statement that he will certainly keep them to the end.
The verse describes the psalmist inclining his heart to perform the statutes to the end, rather than establishing that he will do so.
The verse says his hope is in God's word; it does not say he does not trust his own strength.
Saying his name is not what he is worried about assigns him a feeling the verse does not state.
The explanation quotes the verse and then only says the words are there. It is generic and does not help explain what it means for deceitfulness to be in vain.
